comparisons.title: Southport parking and taxi access

comparisons.title: Oceanview parking and taxi access

comparisons.title: Compact SUV on the rocky trail
comparisons.description: The same descent pilot with a 30-second limit and compact SUV body: the previous build tips onto its roof; corrected rock contact normals keep it on its wheels. The vehicle travels farther after the fix, so the outcome positions differ.
